rootCausesAndRepairs: A genuinely truncated native HTTP transfer can report code 4 with PipelineStatus::PIPELINE_ERROR_READ, not NETWORK_ERR. Retry that exact observed read failure inside the unchanged two-reload, 20-second active-scroll budget; generic unsupported/decode errors still fail closed.

Cold metadata can reset a prematurely assigned seek or correct its fallback duration. Scroll-only seeks now wait for metadata and follow the corrected authored pose; legacy non-scroll fallback behavior remains unchanged.

A healthy five-second first-byte response was cancelled by four-second preparation inactivity. The first scroll preparation now shares the existing six-second response grace, without increasing its one-reload or 19-second outer deadline.

All sixteen scene surfaces received unchanged scrollTop writes on ordinary scroll/media frames. Cache only the owned offset, and reassert it on role or measured-offset changes. The fixed twenty-sample unit comparison removes 320 redundant writes.

localSourceComparison.identity: Ordinary dirty build; not frozen publication qualification. Native fixtures bind the exact driver source and compiler bytes independently.
localSourceComparison.tradeoff: The single-stall control takes about 6.2s versus 4.5s in v70; preserving healthy first-response grace is not free. Both remain inside the original 20s deadline.
localSourceComparison.transport: Byte-identical local asset/CDN remapping, not public-network qualification or an exclusive CDN/proxy root-cause claim.

scroll.interpretation: Desktop task cost decreased in this cohort; phone cost and several pose lags worsened. Blank active-scroll P95 changed from 50ms desktop to 34.4ms phone. Do not claim a stable overall scrolling improvement from this sweep.

phoneCounterbalancedFollowup.interpretation: Reversing the order did not reproduce the original 42% task-cost gap; this cohort differs by about 2.5%, not proof of a stable phone speedup. All original and follow-up FPS failures remain failed.
